measures.reply: led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: board thickness, and the tallest thing on its back face (the 4-pin connector with plug inserted): its height and where it sits relative to the centre
measures.reply: led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; led disk thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: length and width of the board, board thickness, corner hole diameter, and the centre-to-centre spacing of the corner holes along both sides
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: height of the tallest thing above the board's top face (ESP32 on headers), and the tallest thing sticking out below the board (solder joints/pins)
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard grid: 18 x 24 holes at 2.54 mm; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board

measures.what: which board edge the port faces, how far the port mouth is from that edge of the perfboard (sticks out or sits in), its offset along that edge from the board's centre line, its height above the perfboard top face (to the port's centre), and the outer width/height of the USB-C plug body on your charger cable

measures.item: wall screws you'll hang it on
measures.what: head diameter, shank diameter, and how far the heads stand off the wall
measures.reply: wall screws size: #8 round-head screws in 1/4 inch anchors; I bought ones with heads 9 mm across at most; wall screws standoff: I'll leave them about 3.5 mm out from the wall

measures.what: diameter with a ruler or tape across the widest point (roughly is fine, to the nearest mm), and roughly how far the connector/wires stick out from its back face
measures.reply: led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: distance from the mouth of the USB-C port straight to the perfboard edge it faces — and does the mouth stop short of that edge or stick out past it? measures.reply: esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 position: in female headers on the perfboard's columns 8 and 18, rows 2 to 23; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

measures.what: width and thickness of the plastic grip (the moulded body behind the metal tip), and length of the metal tip
measures.reply: I can't measure that. Use your best judgment.

measures.what: hold the perfboard ESP32-side towards you with the USB port pointing down: distance from the perfboard's LEFT long edge to the middle of the USB-C port's mouth; and does the port mouth sit level with the ESP32 board's end, or stick out past it (by how much)?

measures.what: height of the screw terminals and capacitor above the board's top face, and which end of the board they're at (the USB end or the far end)
